## prompt-1-mermaid

*Generated by Process A (the bootstrap milestone) from the single master prompt
in [`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting the
`inputs/auto-bill-02/sub-prompts/prompt-3-mermaid-selection.md` and
`prompt-4-figure-selection.md` conventions to the Physical AI oncology trial
protocol build. Runs in stage `trial-protocol/mermaid/`.*

Author the **Stage 1 Mermaid figure catalog** for the *Phase 1, First-in-Human,
Combined IND/IDE Clinical Trial Protocol of On-Premises LLM-Directed Robotic
Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple) with Perioperative Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) in
KRAS-Mutated Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma* into `trial-protocol/mermaid/`.

**Scope.** Produce **at least 20** new, comprehensive, professional Mermaid
diagrams, each in its own Markdown file (`fig-NN-slug.md`) that opens with a
real ```mermaid``` fenced block so it renders natively in GitHub, followed by a
short caption, the figure's role in the protocol, and the exact
`trial-protocol` source files the figure draws from (Rule 5). Every figure must
be **new to this protocol** - do not re-use any prior author figure development.
All quantitative content (force caps, vessel zones, timings, dose levels,
sample size, advisory windows) must be carried from the author sources so each
diagram is comprehensive, not decorative.

**Color scheme (every figure).** Corporate Blue `#00417A` for end goals,
operative decisions, and the investigational system; Professional Gray
`#6C757D` for process and oversight nodes; Classic White `#FFFFFF` for inputs
and context; black rules and grayscale fills elsewhere. Use `classDef` blocks
with white text on the dark blue/gray fills and dark text on light fills so
contrast is professional. This same five-step palette becomes the TikZ
`mm*` node styles in the LaTeX stages, so emphasis must read by fill and stroke
weight alone.

**Required figure families (expand to 20+; each comprehensive).**
1. Trial schema - screening, enrollment, dose-cohort assignment, surgery,
   perioperative daraxonrasib, follow-up, end of study.
2. CONSORT-style participant flow (screen -> eligible -> enrolled -> treated ->
   analyzed) with screen-failure and withdrawal branches.
3. Combined IND/IDE regulatory pathway (21 CFR part 312 drug + part 812 device,
   Subpart J Physical AI overlay, Phase 0 simulation validation).
4. On-premises LLM advisory control loop (sensors -> mapping -> LLM advisory ->
   safety gate -> robot actuators; second-opinion oracle isolation).
5. Eight-arm PancreSpeed platform architecture (56 DOF, 640 sensor channels).
6. Eight-phase intraoperative timeline (P1 Kocher through P8 hemostasis).
7. Five-vessel vascular safety-zone gate (no_fly / soft_warning / hard_stop;
   E-stop logic).
8. Heartbeat / watchdog / E-stop safety architecture (10 kHz bus, 100 us
   watchdog, 3 ms cross-arm halt, 18 N and 3 N force caps).
9. Daraxonrasib perioperative pause-and-restart advisory (T+7 / T+14 / T+21
   keyed to ISGPS fistula grade and serum trough).
10. 3+3 dose-escalation scheme for the daraxonrasib drug arm.
11. Three anastomoses (PJ duct-to-mucosa, HJ end-to-side, GJ antecolic) with
    ring-tension targets.
12. VVUQ ten-gate assurance pipeline (ACCEPT / BLOCK / ESCALATE).
13. Objectives-to-endpoints hierarchy (primary safety / feasibility, secondary,
    exploratory).
14. Schedule of Activities visit map (screening, surgery day, acute, 30-day,
    long-term follow-up).
15. Adverse-event / SAE and Physical AI AE reporting workflow (7-day and 15-day
    IND/IDE timelines, audit-trail preservation window).
16. Study governance and safety oversight (Sponsor-Investigator, IRB, DSMB,
    Independent Safety Monitor, Physical AI Safety Review Committee).
17. Informed-consent process with the Physical AI opt-out (21 CFR 312.60(f)).
18. Staged autonomy model (clinician-controlled -> supervised -> higher
    autonomy only after independent safety review).
19. The three counterfactual scenarios in which withholding the LLM + robot +
    medicine combination shortens progression-free and overall survival.
20. The eight Physical AI concerns and their mitigations (limitations, patient
    safety, loss of human workers, single-source software, proprietary-model
    dependency, non-domestic open-source LLMs, overly complex workflows, black
    boxes).
21. Hash-chained audit trail and data flow (21 CFR part 11, deny-by-default
    authorization, MCP servers).
22. Statistical analysis populations (ITT / mITT / per-protocol / safety) and
    interim-analysis stopping logic.
23. Author-works LLM-trust timeline (Aug 2024 to Jun 2026) supporting protocol
    validity.
24. Risk-benefit framework for advanced and terminally ill PDAC patients.
25. Sensor-data pyramid (L0 raw on Zenodo through L4 committed aggregates).

**Commit schedule (Rules 6, 7, 8).** One commit per figure file, pushed in real
time (20+ commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors across every
figure file. The last commit writes `trial-protocol/mermaid/README.md` (badges,
repository structure, the colored build Mermaid, a figure inventory table
naming each source file) and `output-mermaid.md` (the narrative output under an
`## output-mermaid` heading). Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan mode.
